text:
mina: Emergency bagel update: the bagel box is empty and there's a single lonely avocado looking sad on the counter :avocado: 

todd: I may have eaten the last sesame bagel at 9:02am. apologies to the team. :grimacing: can someone do a quick run?

julia: I can run at 10:30 if someone covers my standup. who wants which bagels?

kitchen-bot: kitchen stock: plain 0, sesame 0, everything 1, gluten-free 2. cream cheese - low. avocado - 1 ripe. Order suggestion: 6 plain, 6 everything, 4 gluten-free, 2 shmears. Update sheet: https://redwood.internal/kitchen-inventory

harpreet: vote: should we start a "Bagel Bank" fund (voluntary $1/week) so someone can press order without fuss? react :coin: for yes, :x: for no.

zack: :coin: makes sense. also tiny ask: can we have a toaster protocol? last week someone nuked a bagel for 5 minutes and we lost a crumb tray.

mina: toaster guide idea: set to 2 clicks for thin/thin-slice, 3 clicks for thick. please clear crumbs weekly. I'll pin a sticker with steps.

todd: also, avocado etiquette: if you take the last one, please leave a note or replace. we had a sad guacless lunch yesterday.

julia: can we add a small hand tool (avocado slicer) and a plastic cutting board labelled "kitchen-only"? people are using conference room tables to smash avos.

facilities: we can order a board + slicer and a small lockbox for personal lunches. will do one-time purchase. ETA 4 business days.

ops: Bagel Bank approved in principle. I'll seed it this week; can someone volunteer to be the weekly baker/order runner?

mina: I volunteer to be runner this week. I'll do a split order and bring a tub of plain shmear.

harpreet: contribution link please.

ops: venmo link: @redwood-bagelbank. put your slack handle in the note.

zack: small policy suggestion: label all bakery items with name/date and "COMMUNAL" if you intend to share. saves the mystery-grab.

mina: agreed. I'll make a tiny printable label that says: "COMMUNAL - please enjoy! (date)" and tape near the box.

kitchen-bot: inventory reminder set: weekly bagel order every Friday 9am if Bagel Bank balance >= $20.

julia: outcome: runner = mina this week, facilities orders avocado kit + cutting board, toaster sticker + communal labels printed, Bagel Bank venmo set up. Thanks team  brunch mission accomplished :bagel:
